questions.stem: Water ____ at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
questions.explain: 客观事实、科学规律用一般现在时。“is boiling”只表示此刻正在沸腾，不表示普遍规律。
questions.verify: 本单元按“动词时态”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对，如顺序不同，只改文件里的 chapter / order。

questions.stem: I ____ my old classmate in the supermarket the day before yesterday.
questions.explain: the day before yesterday 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时。现在完成时“have met”不能和明确的过去时间状语连用。

questions.stem: When the phone rang, she ____ a bath, so she didn't answer it.
questions.explain: 电话响的那一刻她正在洗澡，用过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作。“took”表示电话响了之后才去洗澡，和后半句不合。

questions.kp: 时间状语从句中用一般现在时表将来
questions.stem: I will call you as soon as I ____ at the airport.
questions.explain: as soon as、when、if 等引导的时间、条件状语从句用一般现在时表示将来，主句才用 will。

questions.kp: 现在进行时表示已安排的将来
questions.stem:
— Are you free tomorrow evening?
— Sorry, I ____ dinner with my parents. We booked a table last week.
questions.explain: 已经安排好的个人计划（订好了座位）常用现在进行时表示将来。一般现在时“have”表示习惯，不表示这种安排。

questions.kp: 一般现在时：第三人称单数
questions.stem: My brother usually ____ (watch) the news after dinner.
questions.explain: 主语是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词要加 -s / -es；以 ch 结尾的动词加 -es。

questions.stem: Last summer we ____ (fly) to Kunming and spent a week there.
questions.explain: Last summer 是过去时间，用一般过去时；fly 的过去式是不规则的 flew（过去分词 flown）。

questions.stem: We ____ go to the cinema — maybe once or twice a year.
questions.explain: once or twice a year（一年一两次）说明次数很少，用 seldom（很少）。

questions.kp: 现在完成时：经历和次数
questions.stem: I ____ this film three times so far, so I don't want to see it again.
questions.explain: so far（到目前为止）表示从过去到现在的经历和次数，用现在完成时。“had seen”需要一个过去的时间作参照。

questions.stem: By the time we got to the cinema, the film ____.
questions.explain: by the time 后接一般过去时，主句的动作发生在那之前，是“过去的过去”，用过去完成时。

questions.stem: He ____ in this company since he graduated from college in 2018.
questions.explain: since 加过去的时间点，主句用现在完成时，表示从那时一直持续到现在。

questions.stem:
— Where is Tom?
— He ____ to the library. He'll be back in an hour.
questions.explain: has gone to 表示“去了某地，现在不在这里”；has been to 表示“去过某地，已经回来了”。Tom 一小时后才回来，说明人还在图书馆。

questions.kp: It is the first time that 句型
questions.stem: It is the first time that I ____ such a beautiful lake.
questions.explain: It is the first time that… 句型中，从句用现在完成时；如果主句是 It was the first time，从句用过去完成时。

questions.stem: Tom said he ____ his keys, so he couldn't get into the house.
questions.explain: 主句是过去时 said，丢钥匙发生在“说”之前，是过去的过去，用过去完成时。

questions.stem: Have you ____ (write) to your parents this month?
questions.explain: 现在完成时的结构是 have / has + 过去分词；write 的过去分词是 written（注意双写 t）。

questions.stem: Up to now, more than 300 students ____ (sign) up for the course.
questions.explain: up to now（到目前为止）是现在完成时的标志；主语 students 是复数，用 have signed。
